subject: Certification roadmap: dependency register, scope clarifications, and questionnaire runbook
messages:
From: Clara Jenkins <clara@clearwateraudit.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff + docs request: ISO/FedRAMP alignment, SOC 2 & CAIQ planning

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for agreeing to run through the certification roadmap with us. As we prepare for the discovery/kickoff session next week we want to gather a short packet so the initial workshops are efficient. Can you provide the following by EOD Monday (PST):

- A current risk register (or a template + sample filled rows) covering ISO 27001 scope candidates and FedRAMP system boundaries
- Inventory of in-scope services (short list: service name, owner, infra location, data categories)
- Any recent evidence packages previously collected for SOC 2 (control names + sample artifacts)
- Answers to a short CAIQ subset we use for scoping (I can send the subset)

The focus for the first phase is scoping and dependency mapping so we can confirm whether Neptune Financial will target FedRAMP Moderate or High and which certs should be parallelized (ISO 27001 vs SOC 2). A few clarifying Qs:

1) Do you already have a proposed system boundary for FedRAMP (VPCs/regions/hybrid on-prem)?
2) Is there an existing ISO 27001 Statement of Applicability or will we be starting a gap assessment from scratch?
3) Who is the internal owner for SIG/CAIQ questionnaire responses?

If possible attach the risk register as an Excel stub and the inventory CSV. If not, a Confluence link will do.

Appreciate it — I’ll send a short CAIQ subset afterwards so your owners can start answers offline.

Best,
Clara Jenkins
Senior Engagement Manager
Clearwater Audit

Attachments: none
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Jenkins <clara@clearwateraudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + docs request: ISO/FedRAMP alignment, SOC 2 & CAIQ planning

Hi Clara — thanks for the clear ask. We can get you a concise packet by Monday EOD. Quick notes and where we’re at: 

- Risk register: attached is our working template (Initial_Risk_Register_template.xlsx). It’s not finalized but includes current top risks and owners.
- Inventory: I’m attaching an export of the minimal inventory for the candidate systems; Marcus will own expanding this with region/service mapping.
- SOC 2 evidence: we have recent evidence artifacts for a subset of controls (logging, IAM, change control). I’ll map those to the control names you’ll want.
- CAIQ subset: please send the subset — we’ll route to the questionnaire owner (Marissa).

Quick answers to your Qs:
1) FedRAMP boundary: we have a proposed boundary that includes our hosted API fleet in us-west-2 plus an interconnect to customer VPCs. We need clarification on whether dual-region replication needs to be in scope for Moderate vs High.
2) ISO SoA: we do not have a finalized SoA; we have a controls mapping draft from the last internal review (Q2). Gap assessment will be needed.
3) Questionnaire owner: Marissa will be the primary for SIG/CAIQ; Marcus will support infrastructure evidence collection.

Proposed timeline:
- Mon (EOD): deliver packet to you (risk register + inventory + SOC 2 index)
- Tue: Clara sends CAIQ subset; Marissa begins responses
- Fri: internal sync to review evidence gaps and owners

I’ve linked the relevant roadmap page here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/Cert-Roadmap-2026 and attached the risk register template.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Rachel Kim
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Quoted message:
> From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>

Action items I’ll take on:
- Lead CAIQ/SIG response coordination (owner: Marissa) — target initial draft in 5 business days after we get the subset from Clara.
- Evidence sampling window: propose we use the last 90 days for operational evidence; auditors typically accept that for controls like logging and patching. If FedRAMP requires 180-day windows for certain controls we’ll note that and pull extended artifacts.
- Map SOC 2 test procedures to artifacts we have (logging config exports, change tickets, IAM policy snapshots).

Marcus: please confirm expected timelines to collect VPC/network diagrams, replication config, and HSM/KMS evidence. If we need to include on-prem interconnect, flag network owners.

I’ll start filling the CAIQ template as soon as Clara shares. Also I’ll prepare a short dependency register that maps downstream customer connectors (Neptune) — that will help clarify FedRAMP boundary work.

Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Clara Jenkins <clara@clearwateraudit.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-23 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + docs request: ISO/FedRAMP alignment, SOC 2 & CAIQ planning

Appreciate the quick reply and the template — that helps. A couple clarifications from our side after a quick read: 

- FedRAMP scope: For Neptune Financial we recommend scoping for Moderate initially unless the customer requires High. The key scoping questions are: (a) is customer data at rest encrypted with KMS under your control, (b) is cross-region replication required for HA in-scope, and (c) are any third-party SaaS connectors included in the control boundary.
- Evidence windows: For FedRAMP Moderate some controls expect 180-day evidence samples for change control and vulnerability management. SOC 2 often allows 90-day sampling for operational controls — we’ll document any deviations.
- CAIQ subset: attached (short_ca iq_subset.pdf) — covers 72 questions we commonly use for initial scoping.

Next steps:
- Let’s do a 45-minute kickoff on Wed 8/25 at 10:00am PT to walk scope and owners.
- Please upload the inventory CSV and any network diagrams to the Drive link you included. We’ll use that to finalize the dependency register and produce a draft evidence plan.

I’ve attached our FedRAMP_Readiness_Checklist to help guide what artifacts you’ll need to surface.

Best,
Clara
Clearwater Audit
